name: Exotic spheres, smooth Poincare in dimension 4 ... Floer to Heegaard
summary: Embedded contact homology proved the Weinstein conjecture in dimension 3.

name: Kapustin-Witten: geometric Langlands as S-duality
summary: Twisted N=4 super Yang-Mills was used to derive Hecke eigensheaves from branes.

name: Thin groups and the affine sieve (Bourgain-Gamburd-Sarnak)
summary: Expansion in Cayley graphs from sum-product theory powers a sieve on orbits of non-arithmetic subgroups of SL_n(Z).

name: Univalent foundations and homotopy type theory
summary: Voevodsky interpreted Martin-Lof type theory in simplicial sets, formulated the univalence axiom, and organised a special year in 2012-13 that launched homotopy type theory and the UniMath library.

name: Tropical geometry transferred to Brill-Noether theory
summary: Degenerating curves to graphs and playing chip-firing games gave new proofs and extensions of classical statements about how many equations are needed to embed a curve.

name: Topological recursion and enumerative geometry
summary: Eynard-Orantin recursion recovers Gromov-Witten and Weil-Petersson volumes.

name: Flag algebras
summary: Razborov turned Turan-type problems into semidefinite programs using limits of graph densities.

name: Guth-Katz distinct distances
from: real algebraic geometry (polynomial partitioning, ruled surfaces)
summary: Guth and Katz used polynomial partitioning and ruled surface results to nearly solve the distinct distances problem.

name: Liouville quantum gravity and mating of trees
to: random planar geometry / Liouville quantum gravity
summary: Duplantier-Sheffield-Miller-Gwynne built random surfaces from Gaussian free field and linked them to SLE.

name: Kontsevich-Soibelman wall crossing
summary: Wall-crossing formulas for DT invariants unify stability conditions and cluster transformations.
